column1: # Performance hint ONLY. This file can never affect coverage.
# Coverage is derived from `ls tests/*.rs` at run time and from nothing else.
# A target missing from this table still runs — it gets DEFAULT_COST, which is
# deliberately HIGH (25s) so an unmeasured new target is assumed expensive and
# lands on a light shard. A stale row naming a deleted target is ignored.
# was a guard pinned against a hand-retyped copy of the list it checked (21 entries
# vs 24 in the schema). A guard that pins X against a hand-written list of X is not
# a guard, it is a duplicate. This table is therefore kept OFF the correctness path.
# Two columns, tab-separated: target name (no `tests/` prefix, no `.rs`) and the
# measured seconds of its `test result: … finished in Ns` line.
# SOURCE: GitHub Actions run 30889929026 (job `rust`, 2026-08-04), captured log.
# Reconciled by TEST NAME, not by log order: that log interleaves cargo's stderr
# `Running tests/X.rs` line into the *previous* binary's stdout block for a handful
# of targets, so positional pairing silently swaps costs between neighbours. The
# 52.85s — exactly backwards, and exactly the row two independent readings of that
# log disagreed on. The values below are the by-name attribution.
# NOT MEASURED, deliberately left out: `conversation_content_persistence`, which was
# added on 2026-08-05 (commit 85e9528), after the measurement run. It therefore rides
# DEFAULT_COST today. That is the quarantine working as designed, not an omission to
# fix in a hurry: it costs balance, never coverage.
# TO REFRESH: the `rust` aggregator prints a predicted-vs-actual table in the job
# summary. It WARNS and never fails — putting drift on the correctness path would
# put this hand-maintained list back on it too.
# Pseudo-units. These are targets `ls tests/*.rs` cannot see, and each one is a
# target that would otherwise be covered by no shard and vanish with nothing red.
# `__lib__` is padded above its measured 6.16s to 26.16 to carry its share of the
# per-shard link/startup cost: whichever shard holds it pays `--lib`'s link.
# Measured 0.00s of run time, but `all doctests ran in 0.91s; merged doctests
# compilation took 0.88s` — and it is a SEPARATE `cargo test --doc` invocation,
# so it pays its own startup. Charged 3.00s.
